title: Count Vowel Substrings of a String
description: A vowel substring is a contiguous substring that consists solely of vowels (`'a'`, `'e'`, `'i'`, `'o'`, `'u'`) and contains all five vowels at least once. Given a lowercase string `word`, return the total number of vowel substrings in `word`.
constraints: word consists of lowercase English letters only.
hints: Reset your window whenever you encounter a consonant.
Inside each contiguous vowel run, track the last seen index of each of the 5 vowels; at index i, the number of valid vowel substrings ending at i is max(0, min(lastVowel) - lastConsonant).

examples.explanation: No contiguous vowel-only substring contains all 5 vowels.
"cuaieuouac" has 7 vowel substrings inside the middle vowel run "uaieuoua".
